verdict.rationale: Workflows have one editable draft and any number of immutable deployed versions, with edits always landing on the draft. Processors are the versioned unit iterated on in Studio, and baseVersion can pin model releases. Evaluation set runs score a specific processor version, which gives a way to review changes before deploying. Missing for 10: an explicit documented rollback or redeploy-previous-version action, a diff or approval-style review of workflow changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
